historicalComparison.importantCaveat: This comparison is NOT apples-to-apples on build mode. The 2026-08-12 historical anchor ran against the DEV server on port 3600 (`npm run dev`, per the doc's cause section referencing `.next/dev/static/development/...`). This 2026-09-15 run was deliberately pointed at the pre-built STANDALONE/PRODUCTION build on port 3639 per this task's explicit instructions (a live dev server / fresh build was out of scope for this worktree). A dev-mode-only MIME diagnostic cannot recur in a production build by construction, so the disappearance of `development-mime-diagnostic` is expected and uninformative; the two NEW failures (equipment JSON 404/aborted fetch, and the ledger-projection timeout) are the operative signal and appear to be standalone-build-specific issues (likely a static-asset-serving or data-path difference between `npm run dev` and the standalone server) that were not exercised by the historical dev-mode run at all.
